help_text:
❓ **AI Image Generation Bot — Help & Usage Guide**

Welcome to your creative AI assistant! Here is how to use the bot:

✨ **How to Generate Images**:
1. **Style Presets**: Click `/generate` or pick a preset from the menu, then send your photo to transform it.
2. **Custom Prompts**: Click *✏️ Custom Text Prompt* to generate directly from text or transform a photo with custom instructions.
3. **Quick Send**: Upload a photo with a caption anytime to transform it instantly.

⚙️ **Available Commands**:
• `/start` — Open the main menu & view credit balance
• `/generate` — Browse style presets
• `/models` — Switch AI generator model
• `/buy` — Check credits or buy with Telegram Stars
• `/settings` — Change bot language & preferences
• `/help` — Display this help message
• `/cancel` — Cancel any active prompt or selection
